import 'dart:async';

enum TunAuthorizationState { none, unauthorized, authorized }
enum AuthorizeCode { success, none, error }
const authorizedTunEnableProvider = AuthProvider();
const patchClashConfigProvider = PatchProvider();
class AuthProvider { const AuthProvider(); String get notifier => 'auth'; }
class PatchProvider { const PatchProvider(); String get notifier => 'patch'; }
class Auth { dynamic value = TunAuthorizationState.none; }
class Tun { final bool enable; const Tun(this.enable); }
class Config {
  final Tun tun;
  final bool ipv6;
  Config(bool enable, {this.ipv6 = false}) : tun = Tun(enable);
  Config.withTun(this.tun, {this.ipv6 = false});
  Copier get copyWith => Copier(this);
}
class Copier {
  final Config c;
  Copier(this.c);
  Config tun({required bool enable}) => Config(enable, ipv6: c.ipv6);
}
class Patch {
  final Ref ref;
  Patch(this.ref);
  void update(dynamic fn) { ref.writes++; ref.config = fn(ref.config); }
}
class Ref {
  final auth = Auth();
  Config config = Config(true);
  bool mounted = true;
  int writes = 0;
  dynamic read(dynamic key) {
    if (!mounted) throw StateError('provider read after dispose');
    if (key == 'auth') return auth;
    if (key == 'patch') return Patch(this);
    if (key is AuthProvider) return auth.value;
    if (key is PatchProvider) return config;
    throw StateError('unknown provider');
  }
}
class Action {
  final ref = Ref();
  final pending = Completer<AuthorizeCode>();
  int calls = 0;
  Future<AuthorizeCode> authorizeCore() { calls++; return pending.future; }
// PRODUCTION_REQUEST_ADMIN
}
void check(bool condition, String message) {
  if (!condition) throw StateError(message);
}
Future<void> main() async {
  for (final code in AuthorizeCode.values) {
    for (final intent in ['unchanged', 'aba', 'off', 'ipv6', 'dispose']) {
      final a = Action();
      final old = a.requestAdmin(true);
      check(a.ref.auth.value == TunAuthorizationState.unauthorized, 'not pending');
      if (intent == 'aba' || intent == 'off') {
        // Real producers write config first; setup may not run until later.
        a.ref.config = Config(false);
        if (intent == 'aba') a.ref.config = Config(true, ipv6: true);
      } else if (intent == 'ipv6') {
        a.ref.config = Config.withTun(a.ref.config.tun, ipv6: true);
        check(await a.requestAdmin(true), 'pending duplicate must continue');
        check(a.calls == 1, 'duplicate native prompt');
      } else if (intent == 'dispose') {
        a.ref.mounted = false;
      }
      final beforeAuth = a.ref.auth.value;
      final before = a.ref.config;
      a.pending.complete(code);
      final result = await old;
      if (intent == 'aba' || intent == 'off' || intent == 'dispose') {
        check(identical(a.ref.config, before), '$intent/$code stale config write');
        check(a.ref.auth.value == beforeAuth, '$intent/$code stale auth write');
        check(result, '$intent/$code stale handoff');
        check(a.ref.writes == 0, '$intent/$code stale update');
      } else {
        check(a.ref.config.tun.enable == (code != AuthorizeCode.error), '$intent/$code ordinary rollback lost');
        check(a.ref.auth.value == (code == AuthorizeCode.error ? TunAuthorizationState.none : TunAuthorizationState.authorized), '$intent/$code wrong auth');
        check(result == (code != AuthorizeCode.success), '$intent/$code wrong handoff');
        check(a.ref.config.ipv6 == (intent == 'ipv6'), 'unrelated field lost');
      }
      print('PASS $intent/$code');
    }
  }
  final disabled = Action();
  check(await disabled.requestAdmin(false), 'off rejected');
  check(disabled.calls == 0, 'off prompted');
  final authorized = Action();
  authorized.ref.auth.value = TunAuthorizationState.authorized;
  check(await authorized.requestAdmin(true), 'authorized rejected');
  check(authorized.calls == 0, 'authorized prompted');
  print('PASS disabled/authorized short circuits; 17 scenarios');
}
